title: Legacy-to-AI Modernization
description: Techlio modernizes legacy systems route by route behind a facade, then adds AI capability on clean services. No rewrite, no feature freeze.
h1: Make the system you have ready for AI, without a rewrite.
intro: Your legacy platform still earns the revenue, and it is also why every AI idea stalls. We modernize it one capability at a time behind a routing facade, then attach AI to the parts that are ready.
caption: Traffic passes through a routing facade that sends each route to the legacy application or a new service, while a change stream keeps data in sync and feeds AI capability.
pains: Every AI proof of concept dies at “we can’t get clean data out of the old system”.
Releases are rare and tense because nobody is sure what a change will break.
The engineers who understand the core modules can be counted on one hand.
A full rewrite has been proposed, estimated and shelved more than once.
stepsIntro: Four steps, in order. The first is a fixed-price diagnostic.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: We read the code, map the seams and data flows, and rank capabilities by risk and by how much AI value they unlock.

steps.title: Put the facade in
steps.text: A routing layer goes in front of the legacy system. Nothing changes for users, and every route can now be moved independently.

steps.title: Carve out the first service
steps.text: One capability is rebuilt with tests and documentation, run in parallel with the old path, then switched over.

steps.title: Add AI and repeat
steps.text: The first AI feature ships on the new service. The next capability follows on a predictable cadence.

why.title: No feature freeze
why.text: The old system keeps shipping while it shrinks. Your roadmap does not stop for the migration.

why.title: Reversible at every step
why.text: Any route can be sent back to the legacy path in seconds, so a bad cutover is an incident, not a crisis.

why.title: No blame for the past
why.text: Legacy code is code that worked long enough to matter. We document it as it is and move forward.

closeText: You get a seam map, a ranked migration plan and an honest view of what AI can do on your stack today.
answer: Legacy-to-AI Modernization prepares an existing system for AI features without rewriting it. Techlio upgrades the parts that block progress, such as outdated frameworks, missing APIs and inaccessible data, in stages, so the system stays in use throughout.

faqs.question: Do we have to rebuild the whole system?
faqs.answer: No. We modernise in stages, starting with the parts that block the AI features you want.

faqs.question: Will there be downtime?
faqs.answer: The work is planned to avoid it, with changes released behind flags and rollback ready.

faqs.question: What makes a system ready for AI?
faqs.answer: Clean, accessible data, APIs that expose the actions an agent would take, an audit trail, and a release process that can test changes safely.
